verdict.rationale: The evidence covers Track/Pipelines APIs for sending data in, broadcast triggering, and MCP for listing automations, but there is no mention of a Reporting/Analytics API or documented endpoints for pulling campaign or flow performance metrics (opens, clicks, conversions, etc.) out to a warehouse or BI tool. Missing for 10: any reporting/metrics API documentation, export/webhook mechanism for performance data, or dashboard-sync examples.
